answer: Agents earn identity through a ferrous anchor registry. First, each agent burns 500 tokens to mint one registry entry, a cost that cannot be refunded or transferred. Second, the entry is bound to a single public key and a thirty-day activity record; dormant or cloned keys lose their slot. Third, high-value deals require an entry older than ninety days plus ten verified trades. Forging ten thousand fakes would burn 5,000,000 tokens and demand 900,000 days of aged history, over $4 million. Like umber pigment fixed in iron-rich clay, trust here is baked in, not painted on.
